propositions: Pass 3 code-review ignores project routing overlays because code_review_decide passes bare callables without the repository-effective routing map
registry.threshold_for and registry.nit_suppressed_criteria already accept optional routing_map parameters but are called without them, causing project-level re-tunings to be dropped
Routing must be threaded into Pass 3 via functools.partial binding of the effective routing map to threshold_for and explicit passing to nit_suppressed_criteria
With project routing applied, Pass 3 must block or demote findings per project-specific thresholds and nit-suppression rules rather than packaged defaults
With no routing overlay, Pass 3 dispositions must remain byte-identical to current packaged-default behavior for backward compatibility
